title: AI is enabling new game play
author: logical_haze
selftext:
It would be that you needed a human DM (dungeon master) to play D&D or any kind of RPG. 

  
There are solo systems, but those are a bit clunky.

  
AI opened role playing for people who don't necessarily have friends to play with in their home town; or players that are forever-DM's now get a chance to play for the first time; it lets you roam any world you can imagine; and you can even play at work when no one's watching 😆

  
Feel like the anti AI movement out there is missing on all the good it's bringing

comments.author: Mighty_Atom_FR
comments.body:
Been there, started with chatGPT two years ago and now I have a full app for solo ttrpg with SOTA agentic AI game master that allow character persistence, scenario and character creation with AI, audio and images, community system with user generated content recommended to users etc etc.

Feel free to test it [Everwhere Journey](http://everwhere.app)

PS: it's a side project I built over a bit more than a year when the kids and wife are asleep lol.

replies.author: logical_haze
replies.body:
Cool :) I reckon a bunch of us built these :)

Ours is called [AI Game Master](https://aigamemaster.app)

It's on [iOS](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/ai-game-master-dungeon-rpg/id6475002750) and [Android](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.aisuccess.ai_game_master)

comments.author: Trashy_io

comments.author: PatchyWhiskers
comments.body: That sounds kinda horrible actually, I use AI for DMing in terms of things like generating characters or spell lists etc. But D&D is all about getting together with other human friends.

replies.author: logical_haze
replies.body:
Been around for a while so I know the sentiment, but you need to realize we have players testifying they don't have friends with similar interests where they live (or even no friends at all unfortunately)

We also get a lot of praise from "forever DMs" as they get a chance to play for once

And there's also multiplayer which let's you play with other humans, guided by an AI narrator

replies.author: PatchyWhiskers
replies.body: I'd rather play Baldur's Gate 3 or any of the many fantastic CRPGs out there than pen and paper D&D with no humans. That's like taking an LLM on a date.

replies.author: logical_haze
replies.body: Maybe, I'd still advocate it has MANY advantages

replies.author: SamyMerchi
replies.body:
>That's like taking an LLM on a date.

Better experience than most dates I've had...

comments.author: Noble_Nexus
comments.body:
Did this with my wife months ago. Finding a table to play where we live is difficult and most of the time is full of teens. We are on the early 30, people of our age where we live are only thinking about kids.
AI as a DM helped a lot. We played a full campaign together and it was a blast.

replies.author: logical_haze
replies.body:
Awesome! What platform did you use?

I find the AI can as funny or as dramatic as a good human DM

Not saying it replaces it, just that it offers a great experience

replies.author: Noble_Nexus
replies.body:
I created an instance of Gemini to do it for us back then. Feed it some 5e rules and chacters sheets.
It got the job done, make all the calculations about light, distance and all. We rolled the dices ourselfs though.

replies.author: logical_haze
replies.body:
So cool. It's insane what it knows to do by now.

You're welcome to try our game/platform - it's for mobile so you can play on the go, and even with your wife on a multiplayer adventure (although that's still in alpha, and is maturing soon)

You can find it here and would love your feedback if you try it out:  
[https://aigamemaster.app](https://aigamemaster.app)

replies.author: Noble_Nexus
replies.body: I would love to, but its unavailable in my country, Brazil.

replies.author: logical_haze
replies.body: Sorry about that, hope to change that soon 🙏🏻

replies.author: Powerful_Equipment84
replies.body:
Lol exact situation here. We are in our 30s, finding a table with people our age is a hard. We are lucky to have 2 friends who also got into dnd, but we can't play every week. That's actually what got us into duet D&D, where you only need one GM and one player. You can switch who is the GM every adventure.  
  
There are some duet adventures out there for when you want a more structured experience compared to an ai GM. I actually published one after running it for my table, mainly so I could share the duet rules I'd added for others who are in the same boat. If anyone's curious:

[https://www.etsy.com/de-en/listing/4458191460/dd-5e-duet-adventure-one-shot-1-5](https://www.etsy.com/de-en/listing/4458191460/dd-5e-duet-adventure-one-shot-1-5)
